rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_unconstrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.3516, n_angles=128, n_det=1024, det_spacing=0.35754, sod=500.0, sdd=1000.0, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.5, train_n=400, val_n=200, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.1, fd_recon_eta=0.1, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, rationale=iter-12: DC-off breast-prior. Fine init_t sweep at low eta=0.1. ONE KNOB init_t 0.2->0.1. PRIOR (low-eta init_t): 0.3->28.98, 0.25->29.20, 0.2->29.58 - monotonically rising as init_t drops (at gentle eta the recon -> light prior-denoise of the FBP init). HYPOTHESIS: init_t=0.1 approaches pure minimal-noise prior-denoise of the FBP -> PSNR near its ceiling; if it saturates/turns, ~0.1-0.2 is the floor. Tests the extreme low-init_t end: as init_t->0 the sampler reduces to FBP passed through ~0 flow-time (identity-ish), so PSNR should approach but not exceed the FBP baseline (the prior can only lightly denoise, never add the missing sparse-view null-space info the DC step would).
